The '''Dread Fortress''' was the bastion of the [[Dread Masters]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Oricon]],

This is where they regrouped following the death of one of their number, Dread Master [[Styrak]], in [[3638 BBY]] during the [[Battle of Darvannis]]. Later that year both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] tracked them to their moon. Both factions sent strike teams into the fortress, where the Dread Master's [[Dread Host|forces]] made their [[Dread War|last stand.]]
